decisions.description: Define the accounting date at which migrated facts become effective.
decisions.implementationImpact: Controls date validation, source selection, and reconciliation windows.
decisions.verificationMethod: Compare the approved reference with manifest dates and target period gates.

decisions.description: Define how much source-system history is included.
permissibleChoices: opening position plus approved outstanding items
decisions.implementationImpact: Changes manifest counts, dependencies, runtime, and comparative reporting.
decisions.verificationMethod: Match extraction dates and counts to the approved history scope.

decisions.description: Define the approved treatment of opening account, bank, cash, receivable, and payable balances.
decisions.implementationImpact: Keeps every opening-balance record policy-gated until approved.
decisions.verificationMethod: Reconcile exact debit and credit totals by entity and currency.

decisions.description: Define treatment of outstanding receivables, payables, and allocations.
permissibleChoices: approved summarized balances with separate lineage evidence
decisions.implementationImpact: Controls invoice, payment, and allocation dependencies and lineage.
decisions.verificationMethod: Reconcile aged balances, allocations, and unapplied amounts exactly.

decisions.description: Define treatment of historical profit and retained earnings.
decisions.implementationImpact: Determines equity opening evidence without inventing a posting rule.
decisions.verificationMethod: Compare approved equity evidence with exact opening totals.

decisions.description: Define treatment of foreign-currency balances and base-currency equivalents.
decisions.implementationImpact: Controls required currency evidence and prevents scope aggregation.
decisions.verificationMethod: Reconcile each currency independently with Decimal-safe comparisons.

decisions.description: Define the authoritative exchange-rate source and applicable timing.
permissibleChoices: approved external reference under a separate provider contract
decisions.implementationImpact: Keeps records carrying exchange rates gated until evidence is approved.
decisions.verificationMethod: Match rate references and timestamps to the approved policy.

decisions.description: Define tax and statutory history and evidence included in migration.
evidenceRequired: tax advisor or authorized Finance approval
decisions.implementationImpact: Blocks tax-bearing records until an approved reference exists.
decisions.verificationMethod: Compare tax codes, totals, dates, and retained evidence to the approval.

decisions.description: Define asset cost, accumulated depreciation, and future schedule treatment.
decisions.implementationImpact: Depreciation source records remain policy-gated.
decisions.verificationMethod: Reconcile asset cost and accumulated depreciation to approved evidence.

decisions.description: Define treatment and authority for partner capital, drawings, salary, and interest transactions.
decisions.implementationImpact: Partner-transaction records remain policy-gated.
decisions.verificationMethod: Match partner scope and totals to independently approved evidence.

decisions.description: Define maker-checker handling for prepared migrated records.
permissibleChoices: separate approved migration operator and business approver roles
decisions.implementationImpact: Execution and approval remain blocked without separate identities.
decisions.verificationMethod: Prove operator and checker identities differ and permissions are least-privilege.

decisions.description: Define the auditable actor identities attributed to migration preparation and approval.
permissibleChoices: named service identity plus human approvals
named human operator and checker identities
decisions.implementationImpact: Prevents anonymous or shared execution identities.
decisions.verificationMethod: Verify active identity ownership and immutable audit linkage.

decisions.description: Define whether and how source document number series continue.
permissibleChoices: approved new target series with retained source reference
decisions.implementationImpact: Controls mapping and collision checks; no sequence is selected automatically.
decisions.verificationMethod: Verify uniqueness, lineage, and approved next-number evidence.

decisions.description: Define treatment of source records dated in closed target periods.
permissibleChoices: approved effective-date transformation with retained source date
decisions.implementationImpact: Closed-period conflicts fail closed until policy evidence exists.
decisions.verificationMethod: Test closed-period fixtures against the approved rule and audit evidence.

decisions.description: Define the source-system freeze scope, timing, ownership, and exception process.
permissibleChoices: approved bounded freeze with controlled exception ledger
decisions.implementationImpact: Final manifest cannot be certified without a stable source boundary.
decisions.verificationMethod: Verify no source changes occurred after the accepted extraction timestamp.

decisions.description: Define which attachments are retained, scanned, stored, and disposed.
decisions.implementationImpact: Attachment execution remains scan-required and provider-disabled.
decisions.verificationMethod: Verify inventory, hashes, scan state, storage scope, and retention evidence.

decisions.description: Define the system of record and synchronization authority for each external provider.
permissibleChoices: approved provider is authoritative under a separate contract
decisions.implementationImpact: All provider adapters remain disabled until separately accepted.
decisions.verificationMethod: Verify provider mode is disabled or matches a separately approved contract.

decisions.description: Define authority and criteria for forward fix, canonical reversal, and infrastructure restore.
decisions.implementationImpact: Posted financial records can never be deleted as rollback.
decisions.verificationMethod: Review each failure stage against the approved authority matrix.

decisions.description: Define the approved retention period for financial records and evidence.
decisions.implementationImpact: No retention duration is invented by the implementation.
decisions.verificationMethod: Match configured retention controls to the approved schedule.

decisions.description: Define retention for manifests, mappings, exceptions, logs, alerts, and rehearsal evidence.
permissibleChoices: approved schedule aligned to financial evidence
decisions.implementationImpact: Operational evidence remains retained pending an accepted schedule.
decisions.verificationMethod: Verify evidence stores and disposal controls against the approved schedule.
